name: lockdown
description: Breach response: encrypt sensitive data in place with a key YOU hold offline, so an attacker on the box can't read it — but you can still recover it.

recipient.about: the PUBLIC key to encrypt to: an age recipient (age1...) or a gpg key id/email. Its private half MUST live off this machine (printed, HSM, a vault) — that's what keeps the attacker (and this agent) out while you keep recovery.

paths.about: where the sensitive data is: space-separated folders/files, e.g. '/var/lib/app/customers /etc/secrets'

patterns.about: which files under those paths count as sensitive (globs)
